map.APC 和 MPC 区别？: What is the difference between APC and MPC?
map.APC 是总消费/总收入（水平量），MPC 是消费增量/收入增量（边际量），后者: APC is total consumption / total income (a level measure), while MPC is the change in consumption / change in income (a marginal measure) and feeds the multiplier. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only; they are not investment advice or a policy basis, and for forecasts and empirical estimates defer to official statistics and textbooks.
map.低收入时借贷消费可使 APC>1（消费超过收入），正常随收入升而降。结果仅作经济: At low incomes, borrowing to consume can push APC above 1 (consumption exceeds income); normally it falls as income rises. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only; they are not investment advice or a policy basis, and for forecasts and empirical estimates defer to official statistics and textbooks.
map.和储蓄率关系？: How does it relate to the saving rate?
map.APS=1−APC，二者互补，APC 降则储蓄率升。结果仅作经济学教学与快速测算: APS = 1 − APC; the two are complementary, so a lower APC means a higher saving rate. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only; they are not investment advice or a policy basis, and for forecasts and empirical estimates defer to official statistics and textbooks.
